nodes.text: Comatose patient with catastrophic irreversible brain injury: exclude hypothermia, drugs, and shock
Comprehensive clinical exam: coma, absent pupillary, corneal, oculocephalic, vestibulo-ocular, and gag reflexes

Ancillary testing (cerebral blood flow studies or EEG) when apnea test cannot be completed or family requests proof
**Absent cerebral blood flow on four-vessel angiography or nuclear scintigraphy:** formal legal declaration of death
Notify organ procurement organization and support family through bereavement

algorithm.title: Adult patient autonomy and treatment refusal

nodes.text: Adult patient (age >= 18) refuses proposed life-prolonging or experimental therapy against family wishes
Assess decision-making capacity: understanding, appreciation, reasoning, and expression of a choice
Respect the competent patient's autonomous decision to decline further disease-directed therapy
**Impaired capacity without advance directive:** surrogate decision-making based on substituted judgment
Offer comprehensive palliative care and symptom management tailored to patient's goals
Facilitate open family meetings with social work and chaplaincy to support grieving parents
